lanes.summary: Fixed the deal classifier so that a completion already documented no longer blocks buying into a deal.
Checked whether the backtest's widest spreads could ever have been traded live. They could not, so the backtest was flattering itself.
Found and removed lookahead in the panels, then re-ran every configuration comparison on the corrected data.
Re-scored the classifier against the corrected panels and wrote the results into the lookahead notes.
Noted an idea: compute markets as a source of lead-lag signals.
Corrected the dashboard's gate tab: the spread cap is four times the bar, not twice.
Added a watchdog on GitHub that raises an alarm if the nightly commit does not arrive, plus a heartbeat ping.
Started a daily snapshot job for compute-market prices, with its evidence shown on the health dashboard. Still open.
Pre-registered and tested whether trend-following on merger arbitrage's idle cash could hedge it. It cannot; the hypothesis was killed.
Taught the classifier that a switch from stock to cash consideration (SYNA) is not a share leg. Still open.
